# harness_platform_idp_integrations (Data Source)

Data source for listing IDP integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Failing ServiceNow and GitHub integrations of an organization.
data "harness_platform_idp_integrations" "example" {
  org_id = "default"
  type   = ["ServiceNow", "GitHub"]
  health = "failing"
}

output "failing" {
  value = data.harness_platform_idp_integrations.example.integrations[*].identifier
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `health` (String) healthy, degraded, failing or unknown.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.
- `scope` (String) self (default), ancestors or descendants of the given scope.
- `search_term` (String) Matches part of the name.
- `type` (Set of String) Only these types.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `integrations` (List of Object) Matching integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))
